turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: नमस्कार, सह्याद्री बँकेत आपलं स्वागत आहे, मी आरती बोलतेय. मी तुमची काय मदत करू शकते?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: हां नमस्कार... माझे पैसे... माझ्या account मधून पैसे गेले हो. काल.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: काळजी करू नका काका, तुमचं नाव सांगा

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: चिन्मय अय्यर. Senior citizen आहे मी.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: हो काका. काय झालं ते सांगा

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: काल सकाळी एक फोन आला... तो म्हणाला मी lineman supervisor बोलतोय, तुमचं लाईट बिल... बिल update नाही, आज संध्याकाळी connection कापणार. मी म्हटलं मी बिल भरलंय. तर तो म्हणाला एक app टाका, टीम व्ह्यूअर quick support, आम्ही check करतो

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: नंबर आठवतोय का काका, कुठून फोन आला होता?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: हो, लिहून ठेवलाय... प्लस नाइन वन, पाच तीन तीन चार सहा, सात चार पाच शून्य पाच

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ओके. त्यानंतर?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: मग त्यानं सांगितलं phone ला हात लावू नका. आणि मग मेसेज आले, बारा हजार पाचशे, मग पंचवीस हजार. मी घाबरलो, phone बंद केला

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: हो काका, मला दिसतंय पाच तारखेला सकाळी दहा पस्तीसला बारा हजार पाचशे माँ भवानी mobi नऊ शून्य आठ सहा at konkanpay ला, आणि दहा चव्वेचाळीसला पंचवीस हजार संदीप राठोड पाच सात दोन पाच at konkanpay ला गेलेत

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: मी यांना ओळखत पण नाही

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: मी लगेच तुमचं debit card आणि UPI block करतेय... card चे शेवटचे चार अंक सात सहा नऊ आठ?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: हो हो बरोबर

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: block झालं काका. TeamViewer app आत्ताच uninstall करा. मी dispute raise करतेय, नंबर लिहून घ्या, D S P दोन शून्य दोन सहा, पाच चार एक सात नऊ

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: पाच चार एक सात नऊ... हो लिहिलं

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: आणि आपण Konkan Mercantile Bank ला lien साठी request पाठवतोय. तुम्ही एक नऊ तीन शून्य वर पण तक्रार करा

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: मला ते online जमणार नाही हो

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: मुलगा किंवा कोणी मदत करेल का? नाहीतर branch मध्ये मदत करतील. दहा working days मध्ये म्हणजे 18-Sep पर्यंत shadow credit चा निर्णय होईल

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: बरं... धन्यवाद ताई

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: नमस्कार, सह्याद्री बँकेतून स्वप्नील बोलतोय. व्यंकट पाटील बोलताय का?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: हो, बोला. मी रात्री chat वर complaint टाकली होती

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: हो सर, त्यासाठीच call केलाय. आधी तुमचं card block करतो. शेवटचे चार अंक नऊ तीन एक सहा?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: हो

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: झालं sir, hotlist केलं आणि UPI पण बंद केलं. आता सांगा नक्की काय झालं

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: शनिवारी सकाळी message आला की आज रात्री साडेनऊला light कट होईल, bill update नाही. मी त्या number ला फोन केला, तो बोलला मी electricity officer राकेश पाटील, billing department. त्याने सांगितलं bill update fee भरायची आहे, app टाका TeamViewer quick support

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ओके सर

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: मग त्यानं screen वर काय काय केलं मला कळलं नाही. मी office मध्ये होतो, नंतर बघितलं तर तीन messages

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: हो sir, दिसतंय. बारा सप्टेंबरला अकरा तीसला दहा हजार, अकरा सेहेचाळीसला चार हजार नऊशे नव्व्याण्णव, आणि अकरा एकोणसाठला अठरा हजार. तिन्ही माँ भवानी mobi नऊ शून्य आठ सहा at konkanpay ला. शेवटच्याचा UTR सहा सात नऊ सात चार चार नऊ दोन तीन नऊ पाच पाच

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Maa Bhavani mobile? मी कधी ऐकलं पण नाही

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sir, मी dispute raise करतो, नंबर DSP दोन शून्य दोन सहा, चार एक नऊ शून्य आठ. Konkan Mercantile Bank ला lien request जाईल. तुम्ही एक नऊ तीन शून्य वर complaint करा आणि ack number आम्हाला पाठवा

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: पैसे कधी परत मिळतील?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: दहा working days मध्ये म्हणजे 28-Sep पर्यंत shadow credit चा decision होईल sir

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: ठीक आहे, पण नक्की call करा

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: नमस्ते, मैं सह्याद्री बैंक से इमरान बोल रहा हूँ, क्या तुषार भोसले जी से बात हो रही है?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: हाँ जी बोलिए, मैंने रात को चैट में लिखा था

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: जी सर, उसी के बारे में। पहले आपका कार्ड ब्लॉक कर देता हूँ, कार्ड के आखिरी चार अंक आठ दो शून्य चार है ना?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: हाँ हाँ, वही

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ब्लॉक हो गया सर। अब बताइए फोन पे क्या हुआ था

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: एक मैडम का फोन आया, नेहा कपूर बोलीं, वीडियो केवाईसी टीम। पहले एक मैसेज भी आया था कि KYC expire हो गया... उन्होंने AnyDesk डलवाया, बोलीं वीडियो KYC के लिए कैमरा चालू करना है

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ओके। फिर?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: फिर बोलीं स्क्रीन पे कुछ मत दबाना हम कर रहे हैं... थोड़ी देर में पच्चीस हज़ार का मैसेज आया। मैंने पूछा ये क्या है तो बोलीं रिफंड हो जाएगा, वेरिफिकेशन है... फिर उन्नीस हज़ार पाँच सौ और

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: जी सर, सिस्टम में चौदह तारीख को चार बजकर उन्नीस मिनट पे पच्चीस हज़ार और चार बजकर चौंतीस पे उन्नीस हज़ार पाँच सौ दिख रहा है, दोनों आर के फैशन्स सात शून्य नौ छह एट नर्मदा पे को। पहले वाले का UTR दो पाँच नौ नौ आठ शून्य दो शून्य छह एक चार एक

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: हाँ वही... वही है

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: सर मैं डिस्प्यूट दर्ज कर रहा हूँ, नंबर है DSP दो शून्य दो छह, एक चार आठ आठ तीन। बेनिफिशियरी बैंक को लीन के लिए रिक्वेस्ट भेज रहे हैं। आप एक नौ तीन शून्य पर भी शिकायत कर दीजिए

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: पैसे वापस मिलेंगे ना? बच्चों की फीस भरनी है

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: सर आपने समय पर बताया है, दस वर्किंग डे में यानी 29-Sep तक शैडो क्रेडिट का फैसला हो जाएगा। AnyDesk अभी हटा दीजिए

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: ठीक है... धन्यवाद भाई

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Sahyadri Bank, this is Suresh. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yeah, my money has been stolen from my account. Twenty nine thousand... almost thirty thousand.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that sir. May I have your name and registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sachin Shinde. Number is plus nine one five four eight three seven, seven nine six four zero.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you Mr Shinde. Please tell me what happened.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Morning I got SMS, dear consumer your electricity will be disconnected tonight at nine thirty because previous month bill was not updated, contact electricity officer. I called. He said name is Rakesh Patil, billing department.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Which number did you call, sir?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Plus nine one, five eight two two three, four five nine nine eight.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Okay. What happened next?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: He said bill is paid but not updated in system, pay small fee. He sent one APK on WhatsApp, Bill Update, I installed. Then I paid four nine nine nine to... some Sandeep. Then after few minutes twenty five thousand gone. I did not do that!

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sir, I can see on your account, sixteenth September, ten fifty eight am, four thousand nine hundred ninety nine to sandeep rathod five seven two five at konkanpay, and eleven twelve am twenty five thousand to maa bhavani mobi nine zero eight six at konkanpay.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Maa Bhavani? Never heard. Why did the bank not stop it? Twenty five thousand going suddenly!

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand sir. First I am blocking your card and UPI right now. Card ending three nine three two?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes. Block everything.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Done sir, card is hotlisted and UPI disabled. Please uninstall that APK immediately and don't open any file from that number. Is the app still on the phone?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes. Wait... okay, deleted.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sir, I am raising a dispute. Your dispute number is D S P two zero two six, three six zero seven four. We will send lien request to Konkan Mercantile Bank for the beneficiary accounts.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: And when will I get money back?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sir, decision on shadow credit within ten working days, by 30-Sep. Also please file complaint on one nine three zero, cyber crime helpline, or cyber crime dot gov dot in, and share the ack number with us.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The four nine nine nine also? I paid that myself.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sir, I am noting everything, the investigation team will decide. I cannot promise on that one.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Fine. Very bad experience honestly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good morning sir, Sahyadri Bank se Nikhil bol raha hoon, aapne app chat pe complaint daala tha paise kat gaye, usi ke liye call kiya hai

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan haan bolo, kuch pata chala?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: sir pehle main aapka debit card aur UPI block kar deta hoon. card ending eight five five five hai na

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan wahi, karo block

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ho gaya sir. ab thoda bataiye call pe kya hua tha

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: ek ladki ka phone aaya, Neha... Neha Kapoor naam bola, video KYC team se. bola KYC expire ho gaya, aaj update nahi kiya to account block. fir bola ek app daalo... any desk, anydisk kuch tha, laal colour ka

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: AnyDesk?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan wahi. fir bola screen pe jo number aa raha hai woh batao, maine bataya. fir ek OTP aaya woh bhi maanga KYC confirm karne ke liye, maine bol diya... galti ho gayi

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: koi baat nahi sir, aapne jaldi bataya achha kiya. system mein nineteen tareekh ke do UPI debit dikh rahe hain, ek thirty five thousand teen baj ke untalees minute pe aur ek nine thousand nine hundred ninety nine teen baj ke ikyavan pe, dono R K Fashions ko, rk fashions seven zero nine six at narmadapay

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: R K fashion? maine kabhi naam nahi suna

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ji sir. main dispute daal raha hoon, D S P two zero two six, six three one four eight. beneficiary bank ko lien ke liye likh rahe hain. aap one nine three zero pe complaint zaroor kariye

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: kitne din lagenge? pension ka paisa tha

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: sir das working days mein decision aayega, 05-Oct tak. aur woh AnyDesk abhi uninstall kar dijiye please

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan beta abhi karta hoon. woh ladki dobara phone kare to?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: sir uthaiye mat, aur koi bhi OTP kisi ko mat dijiye. bank kabhi phone pe KYC nahi karta

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Namaskar, Sahyadri Bank senior citizen desk se Kavya bol rahi hoon, kya meri baat Yogesh Mishra ji se ho rahi hai?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan haan beta bol raha hoon, maine raat ko mail kiya tha na

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ji sir, usi mail ke regarding call kiya hai. Sir aap pareshaan mat hoiye, pehle main aapka card aur UPI block kar deti hoon, theek hai?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan karo karo turant, aur kuch na chala jaaye

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ji sir. debit card ending nine eight six seven hotlist ho gaya hai, UPI bhi band kar diya. Sir call karne wale ne apna naam bataya tha?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan, Neha... Neha Kapoor bola usne. bola video KYC team, head office. bahut politely baat kar rahi thi, mujhe laga bank se hi hai

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: okay sir. aur number wahi tha jo mail mein likha hai, plus nine one five one four six five, two three zero five zero?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan wahi. five one four six five... two three zero five zero

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ji. sir system mein dikh raha hai twenty september shaam five baj ke teen minute pe thirty thousand ka UPI gaya hai, shree sai trader nine nine six eight at narmadapay ko. UTR hai eight two nine eight zero zero seven three nine eight nine zero.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: ye shree sai kaun hai? maine kisi ko nahi bheja. usne bola bas verification hai... phir screen pe apne aap kuch kuch hua

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: samajh gayi sir. woh AnyDesk abhi bhi phone mein hai?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan hai abhi bhi, mujhe hatana nahi aata

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: sir please usko uninstall kar dijiye, main bata deti hoon... settings mein jaiye, apps, phir AnyDesk, uninstall

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: haan... ho gaya, delete ho gaya lagta hai

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ji. sir main dispute raise kar rahi hoon, number note kijiye, D S P two zero two six, four seven two zero nine. beneficiary bank ko lien ke liye request bhej rahe hain. aap please one nine three zero pe bhi complaint kijiye, ya cyber crime dot gov dot in pe

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: one nine three zero... theek hai mera beta kar dega. paisa wapas milega na beta?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: sir aapne time pe report kiya hai, policy ke hisaab se das working days mein shadow credit ka decision aayega, yaani 06-Oct tak. main update deti rahungi

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: theek hai beta. bank wale kabhi KYC ke liye phone nahi karte na?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: nahi sir, bilkul nahi. bank kabhi phone pe KYC ya OTP nahi maangta, na koi app install karwata hai. dhanyavaad sir, dhyan rakhiye

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good morning, am I speaking with Mr Rahul Agarwal? This is Pooja from Sahyadri Bank senior citizen desk, calling about your message on social media.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, yes. Finally somebody called. I have been waiting since morning.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am really sorry sir. First thing, I am blocking your debit card and UPI so nothing more goes out. Card ending nine eight eight seven, correct?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes that's the one. Please block.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Done sir, it is hotlisted. Can you tell me what happened on the call?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I got an SMS first, KYC expired, account will be blocked in 24 hours, call KYC officer. So I called that number, five nine seven four nine, five five five four three. One Vikas Sharma picked up, said he is from KYC verification cell, head office.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Okay sir. Did he ask you to install any app?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: He made me download something... for video KYC. I, uh, I don't remember the name. Then he said stay on the line, don't touch the screen. After that two messages of debit came.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes sir, I can see two UPI debits yesterday, twenty fifth September. Nineteen thousand five hundred at two ten pm to shree sai trader nine nine six eight at narmadapay, and twenty four thousand at two nineteen pm to rk fashions seven zero nine six at narmadapay.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Twenty four thousand to whom? R K what?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: R K Fashions sir, account with Narmada Small Finance Bank. Did you share any OTP?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No OTP. I did not give any OTP. He was doing everything himself.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Understood sir. I have raised dispute number D S P two zero two six, eight zero five two six. We are sending lien request to the beneficiary bank today itself. Please also report on one nine three zero or cyber crime dot gov dot in, it helps in freezing the money.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: My son will do it online. How long for the money?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sir as per policy, shadow credit decision within ten working days, that is by 12-Oct. You reported within one day, so zero liability applies if there is no negligence.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hmm. And that app thing is still on the phone, I don't know how to remove.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will stay on the call sir, please open settings, then apps...

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It says AnyDesk. Uninstall? Okay... done.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you sir. I will call you on Monday with an update.
